This inequality, $v_{prog} \gg P_{NFL}$, forms the foundational axiom of our sovereign primitive. Furthermore, the inclusion of advisory weights (Quote 10) introduces a Bayesian updating mechanism. Thus, the derivation confirms that the 'snub' is not an anomaly, but the mathematically inevitable output of the defined utility functional.
